name: Wikipedia
label: Wikipedia MediaWiki API
description: Official MediaWiki Action API + REST page summary on English Wikipedia (OfficialApiNode is single-host: en.wikipedia.org). search, get_page, get_summary, get_extract. No key. Set a contact User-Agent at the daemon. CC BY-SA attribution required. Do not scrape HTML.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-invoke fields for Wikipedia. Do not put secrets here. Example: {"operation":"search"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation. EXACT: search | get_page | get_summary | get_extract. Example: 'search'.

schema.label: titles
schema.description: get_page / get_extract REQUIRED. Page title. Example: Business_Process_Model_and_Notation.

ports.name: output
ports.description: OfficialApiNode result: {status,http_status,data} on 2xx. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: status
schema.description: Present on HTTP 2xx. EXACT: 'ok'. Absent on failure. Example: 'ok'.

schema.label: http_status
schema.description: HTTP status from the provider. Example: 200.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body (or raw text if not JSON). OfficialApiNode places the provider payload here. Example: provider object.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is blank. EXACT: search | get_page | get_summary | get_extract. Example: 'search'.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout Seconds
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read timeout seconds. Default 25. <=0 falls back to 25. Example: 25.
